properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 9 at 11:53AM CDT until August 9 at 2:00PM CDT by NWS Chicago IL
properties.description:
SMWLOT

The National Weather Service in Chicago has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...

Nearshore Waters from Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor...
Open Waters from Winthrop Harbor to Wilmette Harbor out to Mid
Lake...

* Until 200 PM CDT.

* At 1153 AM CDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from near Racine to 10 nm northeast of McHenry to 27 nm
northwest of Elgin, moving east at 35 knots. Storms will be near
the nearshore waters around 1230 PM.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Winthrop Harbor and Waukegan Harbor.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued August 9 at 12:19PM CDT until August 9 at 1:45PM CDT by NWS Milwaukee/Sullivan WI
properties.description:
SMWMKX

The National Weather Service in Milwaukee/Sullivan has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Lake Michigan from Sheboygan WI to Winthrop Harbor IL 5 nm off
shore to mid lake...

* Until 145 PM CDT.

* At 1218 PM CDT, severe thunderstorms capable of producing
waterspouts were located along a line extending from 18 nm east of
Port Washington to 7 nm east of Winthrop Harbor, moving east at 30
knots.

HAZARD...Waterspouts, wind gusts to 40 knots, and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Waterspouts can easily overturn boats and create locally
hazardous seas. Small craft could be damaged in briefly
higher winds and suddenly higher waves.

* Severe thunderstorms will remain over mainly open waters.
properties.instruction:
Thunderstorms can produce sudden waterspouts. Waterspouts can easily
overturn boats and create locally hazardous seas. Seek safe harbor
immediately.

Frequent lightning is occurring with these storms. If caught on the
open water stay below deck if possible, keep away from ungrounded
metal objects.

properties.description:
SMWGRR

The National Weather Service in Grand Rapids has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Nearshore and Open Waters from St Joseph to Pentwater MI...

* Until 415 PM EDT.

* At 107 PM EDT, strong thunderstorms were located along a line
extending from 9 nm northwest of Sheboygan to 17 nm east of North
Pt. Lt. to 10 nm southeast of McHenry, moving east at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts to nearly 50 knots and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Small craft could be damaged in briefly higher winds and
suddenly higher waves.

* Locations impacted include...
Saugatuck Pier Heads, South Haven Light, St. Joseph Light, White
Lake Pier Heads, Mona Lake Channel, The White Lake Pierheads,
Little Sable Point Light, Grand Haven Light, Muskegon Light, and
St. Joseph.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.
